2607.07052.title: Progressive Crystallization: Turning Agent Exploration into Deterministic, Lower-Cost Workflows in Production
2607.07052.paper_summary: AI agents deployed for IT operations are typically permanent cost centers because every execution requires full LLM inference, even for previously solved problems. This paper introduces progressive crystallization, a lifecycle that treats agent exploration as a discovery mechanism rather than a permanent execution model. It defines a three-stage execution taxonomy, from fully agent-orchestrated to hybrid to fully deterministic workflows, together with an evidence-based promotion mechanism that converts repeatedly validated agent behaviors into cheaper and more reproducible deterministic workflows, while automatically demoting workflows that regress. Evaluated on a production cloud networking AIOps system processing tens of thousands of incidents per month, the approach increased deterministic execution from 0% to 45% over eight months, reduced per-incident agent costs by more than 70% despite doubling incident volume, and improved safety through greater reproducibility and auditability. The paper also presents the execution taxonomy, promotion and demotion criteria, trace extraction methodology, economic model, safety considerations, and discusses limitations and threats to validity.
2607.07052.paper_summary_zh: AI 代理在 IT 操作中部署通常是永久性成本中心，因為每次執行都需要完整的 LLM 推理，即使是對於先前解決的問題。本文介紹了漸進式結晶化，這是一種將代理探索視為發現機制而非永久執行模型的生命週期。它定義了一個三階段的執行分類法，從完全由代理協調到混合，再到完全確定性的工作流程，並提供了一個基於證據的晉升機制，將重複驗證的代理行為轉換為更便宜且更可重複的確定性工作流程，同時自動降級那些退步的工作流程。在一個每月處理數萬個事件的生產雲網絡 AIOps 系統上進行評估，該方法在八個月內將確定性執行從 0% 提高到 45%，儘管事件量翻倍，但每個事件的代理成本降低了超過 70%，並通過更大的可重複性和可審計性提高了安全性。本文還介紹了執行分類法、晉升和降級標準、追蹤提取方法論、經濟模型、安全考量，並討論了局限性和有效性威脅。
2607.07052.author: Arun Malik et.al.
